name: inventory_add_duplicate_name_bug
task: inventory_add() always appends a new entry, even if an item with the same name already exists. This creates duplicate entries for the same product instead of consolidating stock, which corrupts inventory_find() (only the first entry is ever reachable) and inflates totals incorrectly. Fix inventory_add() so that if an item with the given name already exists, its quantity is increased by the new quantity and its price is updated to the new price, instead of a new entry being appended. Do not change the function's signature.
